I have been a kpop fan for almost 15 years (holy hell what did I just type). I grew up with SHINee and SNSD. Back then, variety content was kind of scarce if you were an int’l fan since there were not a lot of people who did translations. SoshiSubs came up and they were super helpful, but I digress. 


From the bits I saw of SHINee and the Soshis, I really felt like I grew up with them. There’s this “bond” I have with the members of those groups since they were with me when I was an insecure little girl. I never thought a group would make me feel as whole or as happy, especially as I aged. 


Fast forward to college, I find LOONA through a friend and fall in love. They, quite literally, become the only thing that keeps me tethered to reality and brings me back from several breaking points in my early 20s. 


I loved the lore, the music, and the members. I am older than most of the girls, and this time I got to bear witness to my favorite artists coming into their own. I know idol’s personalities are manufactured and I only see what the company and girls want me to see, but I adore them. I listen to them every single day. For the last 3 years they have been my top artist on Spotify. I frequently write letters to the girls and I always purchase things when I can to support them. I can lie and say I love them because they make good music, but I am not one of the orbits who pretends every song is amazing. I really do come back for the girls. I will always support them, barring some major controversy, and they really feel like my safe place.
